ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the scope of Medicaid fraud across the US, including the amounts lost and the individuals and organizations involved.
questions: How much money is lost to Medicaid fraud each year?
What are the most common types of Medicaid fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and highlight the need for greater oversight and accountability in the Medicaid system.

ideas.title: The Somali Daycare Fraud Scandal
ideas.description: Investigate the scope of Somali daycare fraud in Minnesota, including the amounts lost and the individuals and organizations involved.
questions: How much money is lost to Somali daycare fraud each year?
What are the root causes of this type of fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to shed light on a significant issue affecting the Somali community in Minnesota and highlight the need for greater oversight and accountability.
